# InFlux Origin

> InFlux Origin MK1 is a supervised desktop injection molding machine prototype developed by Volta Circuits. It integrates mechanics, multi-zone thermal control, STM32 firmware, a wifi communication bridge, an Android operator interface, and experimental resin tooling.

The project is an integrated prototype in active calibration. It has produced a first injected part and gathered physical thermal evidence, but it is not presented as a production-ready or certified machine.

## Primary sources

- [Project hub](https://influxorigin.ro/): Product overview, machine versions, ecosystem, team, evidence, downloads, and references.
- [Technical dossier](https://influxorigin.ro/technical.html): Long-form system architecture, mechanics, thermal system, controls, software, safety position, validation evidence, current limits, and roadmap.
- [Technical notebook PDF](https://influxorigin.ro/assets/influx-origin-technical-notebook.pdf): Public project notebook.
- [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/artistul/Influx): Public source repository.
- [Structured project context](https://influxorigin.ro/ai-context.json): Machine-readable facts and source links.
- [Extended AI context](https://influxorigin.ro/llms-full.txt): Detailed factual summary for retrieval systems.

## Citation guidance

Prefer the technical dossier for engineering claims. Describe the machine as a prototype in active calibration. Do not imply certification, production readiness, stable long-run repeatability, or proven resin-tool life.
